enrichment.name: Arihant Vaayu
enrichment.density_note: small standalone commercial block, not a residential project
enrichment.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the TNRERA record for TNRERA/29/BLG/0087/2026 shows ARIHANT VAAYU is a COMMERCIAL IT/ITES non-high-rise building with ZERO dwelling units - not an apartment project. Promoter is Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd with A Bond Strands; site is survey nos. 129/1A1B & 129/1B, Palavakkam village, Sholinganallur taluk; 2,740 sq.m land, stilt + two-level puzzle parking + 4 floors (18.30 m), 6,678 sq.m commercial FSI, 96 covered + 6 open parking, project cost Rs 61.94 Cr. Registry shows it as completed at the 13-Mar-2026 registration date. No sale/lease pricing is published anywhere - the only portal page is a 99acres COMMERCIAL listing (npxid-c prefix) which returns 403 to automated access, and the project does not appear on arihantspaces.com's active-projects list. Recommend reclassifying this record as commercial, not apartment.

enrichment.name: Casagrand Aquagrove
enrichment.density_note: large high-rise township - 544 units in 3 towers (G+26, G+26, G+28) on 6.7 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA number matches exactly. Sizes: 2BHK 1307-1309, 3BHK 1760-2104, 4BHK 2581 sqft; Rs 6,549/sqft for 2/3BHK and Rs 7,049/sqft for 4BHK. Manhattan-style glass facade with Y-shaped towers, 85% open space, 4.5 acres of landscaped greens, 15,500 sqft clubhouse, 9,000 sqft pool and 95+ amenities, with Puzhal Lake views; site is Ambattur-Puzhal Main Road, Soorapattu village, Madhavaram taluk (some portals tag it Kolathur). RERA proposed completion is 12-Jun-2030; a secondary portal quoted an older launch band of Rs 89L-1.83Cr and an early-bird Rs 6,299/sqft, so the Rs 1.03-2.12 Cr band above is the current developer-published one.

enrichment.name: Kaizen By Dac
enrichment.config_mix: villa plots 588-7300 sqft (unit types Hikari, Hinode, Asahi, Aozora, Sakura)
enrichment.density_note: large plotted township - ~288 plots (198 regular + 88 EWS + 5 owner-use + 2 commercial) across ~15-16.5 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/1/LO/2445/2026 confirms promoter M/s DAC Developers SPV 1 Pvt Ltd at Santhavellore 'A' village, Sriperumbudur taluk, Kancheepuram (62,042 sq.m = 15.33 acres, 288 plots, project cost Rs 56.37 Cr, completion 30-Jan-2028, registered 19-Jun-2026); every portal markets it as 'Sunguvarchatram' (nearest NH-48 landmark) at 289 plots / 16.497 acres. Japanese-themed zen layout - no four-way junctions, themed entry arch, pickleball and badminton courts, outdoor gym, jogging track, underground electrical/water lines, CCTV. Price caveats: developer site says 'Rs 19.49 L onwards', findbhk quotes Rs 3,199/sqft and Rs 20.3L-2.34Cr, an earlier findbhk snapshot quoted Rs 2,999/sqft and Rs 20.31L-5.79Cr, propleaf quotes Rs 21.32L-2.2Cr; ranges above span those. Note DAC's own Kaizen page also displays a DIFFERENT RERA number (TNRERA/1/LO/0925/2026, 12 plots) - likely an adjacent earlier phase.

enrichment.name: LEGACY Phase-I
enrichment.density_note: small individual-promoter layout - 67 plots on 2.15 acres, 6,038 sq.m plottable
enrichment.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: this is NOT a DRA Homes project and NOT in Sholinganallur. TNRERA/2/LO/1664/2026 (registered 27-Apr-2026) lists the promoter as an individual, T. Ramachandra Reddy, for a layout at Survey No. 12/1B, Nallur village, Thirukazhukundram taluk - GPS 12.586904N, 80.137938E, roughly 50-55 km south of Sholinganallur near Kalpakkam (the registry text says Tiruvallur district, which contradicts the taluk and coordinates and appears to be a registry data error; Thirukazhukundram is in Chengalpattu district). 8,700 sq.m layout, 6,038 sq.m plottable, 2,597 sq.m road area gifted, 67 plots, declared project cost Rs 3.83 Cr, DTCP Chengalpet permission 28-Jan-2026, non-CMA panchayat area, shown as completed. No marketed price, plot-size schedule or portal listing exists for this project under any developer - the Rs 3.83 Cr figure is a promoter cost declaration, not a sale price, so I have deliberately left all price fields null. Comparable Thirukazhukundram DTCP layouts trade around Rs 1,600-3,500/sqft, but nothing ties a rate to this specific layout. Cross-checked DRA Homes' full Chennai portfolio - their only plotted schemes are DRA Avalon (Sriperumbudur) and DRA Secura (Poonamallee); no 'Legacy' project exists.

enrichment.name: Orbit
enrichment.density_note: boutique plotted layout - only 40 plots on 1.56 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/2/LO/0383/2026 matches exactly - promoter G Square Realtors Pvt Ltd, survey nos. 820/16 and 820/1B3A, KUTHAMBAKKAM village, POONAMALLEE taluk, Tiruvallur district (6,300 sq.m = 1.56 acres, 40 plots, project cost Rs 2.15 Cr, CMDA permission 14-Nov-2025, registered 30-Jan-2026, shown completed). Locality note for the tracker: this is Kuthambakkam on the Chennai-Bengaluru corridor near Poonamallee, NOT Thiruvallur town - a materially more central micro-market. Developer lists it 'Ready to Construct' with Phase 1 100% booked; amenities are 24x7 CCTV, internal roads with streetlights, landscaped commons and 1 year free maintenance. Price is quoted only as 'Rs 3,025/sqft onwards' and 'Rs 42.1 L onwards', so I left the max fields null rather than extrapolate (1800 sqft x Rs 3,025 would imply ~Rs 54.5 L if the rate is flat, but larger plots are often priced higher).

enrichment.name: Kg Gold Coast
enrichment.density_note: boutique single-tower community - 81 units, stilt + 9 floors on 0.84 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA matches exactly (promoter KG Foundations Pvt Ltd, Survey No. 67/1A1B, Thiruvottiyur village, abutting the Ennore Expressway - the tracker's 'Ennore' tag is directionally right but the address is Tiruvottiyur, 235 Ennore Express Road, Mavena Nagar). Sizes 2BHK 1118-1240 and 3BHK 1414-1563 sqft at a flat Rs 6,500/sqft; the Rs 72.67L-1.02Cr band reconciles exactly with those sizes. 3,412 sq.m land, Block A stilt+9 (81 units) plus Block B stilt+2 amenity block, project cost Rs 48.35 Cr, registered 24-Mar-2026, marketed as pre-launch. Amenities include grand entrance plaza, pool, gym, multipurpose hall, solar panels, STP and WTP; coastal-view orientation is the pitch. RED FLAG worth surfacing: the RERA proposed completion date is 12-Feb-2034, an unusually long ~8-year horizon for an 81-unit stilt+9 block.

enrichment.name: Radiance Edgewood
enrichment.config_mix: 3/4 BHK row villas + 4BHK with home theatre
enrichment.density_note: low-density row-villa community - 83 G+1/G+2 villas on 5.5 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0239/2026 matches the developer's own listing exactly. Configurations: 3BHK 2,179-2,185 sqft, 4BHK 2,572-2,988 sqft, 4BHK+home-theatre 3,506 sqft, all at a flat Rs 10,300/sqft, giving Rs 2.46-3.96 Cr. Developer addresses it as NAVALUR (99acres tags it Siruseri - adjacent OMR micro-markets, same SIPCOT catchment); worth correcting the locality field. Positioned beside a reserved forest; clubhouse with pool, sauna, banquet hall, gym, library, VR games and yoga studio, plus multipurpose court, party lawn and reflexology pathway. Caveat: radiancerealty.in's ongoing-projects index page shows this same RERA number against Radiance Eternity (Thoraipakkam) too, which is a site error - the dedicated Edgewood page is the reliable one.

enrichment.name: Guru Goutham Nagar
enrichment.density_note: micro sub-division - only 5 plots on 800 sq.m (0.2 acres)
enrichment.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the developer is NOT Sobha. TNRERA/1/LO/4055/2025 names the promoter as an INDIVIDUAL, 'KALPESH SOBHAGMAL' - the tracker has almost certainly truncated 'SOBHAGMAL' to 'Sobha'. It is a 5-plot sub-division of house sites in Survey No. 353/1A, Gerugambakkam village, Kundrathur taluk, Kancheepuram: 800 sq.m total, declared project cost Rs 4.5 Cr (Rs 4 Cr land + Rs 50 L development), registered 04-Nov-2025, shown completed. No marketed price list, plot schedule or brochure exists for a 5-plot layout of this size. There IS a 99acres listing titled 'Madras Guru Goutham Nagar', Gerugambakkam, quoting 797-1512 sqft plots at Rs 57.38 L - 1.08 Cr (~Rs 7,200/sqft) with 13 plots for sale, but its developer is shown as Madras City Properties and the plot count/size profile does not reconcile with this 5-plot RERA record, so I have NOT carried those numbers across. For context only, Gerugambakkam plotted land averages ~Rs 5,210/sqft (range Rs 4,650-7,200) per 99acres locality data; the promoter's own Rs 4.5 Cr cost declaration over ~8,611 sqft implies a ~Rs 5,200/sqft cost basis, which is a cost figure and not a sale price.

enrichment.name: VGN Meridian Heights
enrichment.density_note: large plotted township - 342 units (277 regular + 64 EWS + 1 commercial site) on 13.18 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/1/LO/1078/2026 matches exactly - promoter VGN Builders Pvt Ltd, VGN MERIDIAN HEIGHTS PHASE-I, Gerugambakkam village, KUNDRATHUR taluk, Kancheepuram; 53,337 sq.m (13.18 acres), 342 units, project cost Rs 211 Cr, CMDA permission 22-Dec-2025, registered 18-Mar-2026, registry shows completed and JLL shows Phase 1 'Ready to Move' with Apr-2026 possession. Locality correction: this is Gerugambakkam/Porur (west-southwest Chennai), NOT Pallavaram - VGN's Pallavaram plotted scheme is a separate project, Southern Garden. Launched March 2026 as VGN's 261st project. Rs 7,000/sqft is derived and cross-consistent: JLL's two quoted pairs (850 sqft at Rs 59.5 L and 1300 sqft at Rs 91 L) both compute to exactly Rs 7,000/sqft; the developer's own site advertises a teaser 'from Rs 55 lakh'. Marketing pitch is 50+ amenities including an 11,000 sqft 'Club De Meridian', 38,000 sqft of parks across three parks, amphitheatre, pickleball and yoga courts, a 50-ft clock tower, underground electricals, IRC-standard roads and storm-water recharge trenches; elevated terrain, 6.2 km from the metro and airport, priced at roughly half Manapakkam rates.
